# Codex JSON protocol fixtures

Tested CLI family: `codex-cli 0.144.4`.

`success-0.144.4.jsonl` is a redacted success-shape capture. Specialized
authentication, rate-limit, and provider mappings are intentionally disabled:
no authoritative account-state capture or versioned schema fixture was
available during implementation. Unknown events therefore remain the truthful
generic `CODEX_REVIEW_CODEX_EXIT_NONZERO` classification.
